title: Traceable Scholarship: Page Anchors and Ariadne's Thread for Humanistic Inquiry in the Age of Generative AI
abstract: arXiv:2607.20916v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Generative AI lets large language models produce scholarly-looking text within seconds, yet fluency does not equal valid explanation. The deepest risk is not factual error alone but the appearance that an explanation is already established without clear sources, page numbers, editions, or evidence. We liken the page anchor to Ariadne's thread: within the labyrinth of generative fluency, it is the thread that leads the scholar back to the source. This paper proposes Traceable Scholarship as the minimum normative condition for AI-assisted humanistic research, situating it across the three revolutions of knowledge infrastructure: print, digital, and generative AI. We introduce page anchors, dual page numbers, citation-first generation, NO_EVIDENCE, human verification, four-level compliance, and Scope Contract, and present AIH-Infra as a three-layer reference implementation: Contexture (document structuring), Open WebUI AIH-Infra (tracea

translated_title: 可追溯学术：生成式AI时代人文研究中的页锚与阿里阿德涅之线
translated_abstract: 生成式AI使大型语言模型能够在几秒钟内生成貌似学术的文本，然而流畅性并不等于有效的解释。最深层的风险不仅在于事实错误，更在于解释似乎已经确立却缺乏明确的来源、页码、版本或证据。我们将页锚比作阿里阿德涅之线：在生成式流畅性构成的迷宫中，它是引导学者回归文本源头的线索。本文提出“可追溯学术”作为AI辅助人文研究的最低规范性条件，并将其置于知识基础设施三次革命（印刷、数字和生成式AI）的历史脉络中。我们引入了页锚、双页码、引用优先生成、NO_EVIDENCE机制、人工验证、四级合规以及范围契约，并提出了AIH-Infra作为一个三层参考实现：Contexture（文档结构化）、Open WebUI AIH-Infra（可追溯性……）
tldr: 本文提出“可追溯学术”作为AI辅助人文研究的最低规范条件，通过页锚、双页码、引用优先生成、人工验证等机制，确保生成式AI辅助下的每一个学术论断都能追溯到明确的文本来源。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Traceable Scholarship as the minimum normative condition for AI-assisted humanistic research, introducing page anchors, dual page numbers, citation-first generation, and human verification mechanisms to ensure every scholarly claim produced with generative AI can be traced back to verifiable textual sources.
